facts.statement: The Community Event Bristlewood Bash was held in the highest towers of Tanglewood Fort, in Briarwood, on Friday February 5th, 2010.
facts.quote: Join us in Briarwood for a special party in the highest towers of the Tanglewood Fort!

facts.statement: The event ran on Server 1 for both the U.S./Latin America time slot and the UK/Europe time slot.
facts.quote: 3pm Pacific Time (U.S. and Latin America) Server 1

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news page announcing the Community Event 'Bristlewood Bash', a party in the towers of Tanglewood Fort near Briarwood, on Friday February 5th, 2010. Members get a teleport to the party from the Briarwood Party Planner, and anyone can reach it via the Game Guide calendar during the event.
